items.title: Start-up insurance brokers face insurer agency hurdles as FCA authorisation speeds up
items.summary: While regulatory authorisation times are shrinking for new direct brokers, securing insurer agencies without an existing book of business remains a significant challenge.

items.title: Renters' Rights Act extends duration and claims exposure for landlord insurance
items.summary: The Renters' Rights Act changes possession claims and rent arrears thresholds in England, extending claim durations and unoccupancy periods for landlord policies.

items.title: Howden Re forecasts Lloyd's consortium premiums to exceed £11bn by 2030
items.summary: Howden Re research indicates that underwriting consortia at Lloyd's could account for up to 15% of the market's total premium income by the end of the decade.

items.title: XPS Pensions Group reports 12% revenue increase to £144.3m in half-year results
items.summary: XPS Pensions Group has posted its 14th consecutive half year of year-on-year revenue growth, driven by advisory and administration demand.

items.title: Root Platform Launches /integrated podcast focusing on insurance partnerships
items.summary: Root Platform has introduced a new podcast exploring insurance ecosystems, featuring discussions with MGA leaders and capacity providers.

items.title: Boost Insurance approved as Lloyd's coverholder and expands capacity panel
items.summary: Specialty MGA platform Boost Insurance has secured approval as a Lloyd's coverholder alongside an expansion of its global reinsurance panel.
